notation.t: absolute time in seconds; every draw is f(t), no timers
notation.e: eased progress: easeOutCubic(p), easeInOutCubic(p), or spring(t - t0, k, d) from presets snappy[320,30] ui[220,28] camera[90,19] heavy[120,22] playful[260,14]
notation.A, B: outgoing / incoming scene renderers: A(ctx, t) and B(ctx, t). For compositing, render each into its own offscreen canvas cA, cB every frame, then composite onto ctx
notation.hash(i, seed): deterministic 0..1 from integer i (e.g. mulberry32 or sin-fract hash). Never Math.random()
notation.noise2(x, y): seeded 2D value/simplex noise; animate by sampling noise3(x, y, t * speed) so it is time-pure
notation.frame: Math.round(t * fps); use for per-frame grain seeds so a re-render is identical
notation.spring scaling: to change tempo by factor s, multiply k by s^2 and d by s (keeps damping ratio d / (2*sqrt(k)) constant; settle time scales by 1/s)

transitions.name: hard-cut
transitions.description: Instant switch from A to B on a single frame.
transitions.when_to_use: Default between shots; on the beat; fast action; to create impact. School of Motion lists it as the most useful transition.
transitions.implementation: if (t < tc) A(ctx,t); else B(ctx,t);  // snap tc to beat grid: tc = round(tc*bps)/bps

transitions.name: match-cut
transitions.description: Cut where a shape, position or motion in A lines up with a similar one in B (circle -> sun, logo dot -> planet).
transitions.when_to_use: Show one thing becoming another, passage of time, relationships between objects. Cut at the fastest point of motion.
transitions.implementation: Animate matching element to the same center/scale in both scenes: A ends with obj at (cx,cy,r); B starts with its obj at (cx,cy,r). Hard-cut at tc where velocity peaks.

transitions.name: cut-on-action
transitions.description: Cut mid-gesture to a new framing that continues the same action (click starts in wide, lands in close-up).
transitions.when_to_use: UI demos: cursor starts a click in the wide shot, ripple completes in the zoomed shot.
transitions.implementation: Shared action clock: actionP = clamp((t-ta)/da); A draws actionP up to tc, B draws the same actionP after tc with a different camera transform.

transitions.name: smash-cut
transitions.description: Abrupt cut from quiet to loud (or reverse), usually with an audio hit.
transitions.when_to_use: Punchlines, contrast, hype openers, 'but then...' beats.
transitions.implementation: Hard cut at tc + 2-frame white flash: if (t-tc < 2/fps) {ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H)}; pair with audio transient at tc.

transitions.name: j-cut-l-cut
transitions.description: Audio leads (J) or trails (L) the picture cut by 0.3-1.5 s.
transitions.when_to_use: Any narrative edit; makes cuts feel smooth without a visual effect. Purely an audio-timeline offset.
transitions.implementation: Picture: hard cut at tc. Audio (ffmpeg): start B's audio at tc - lead (J) or keep A's audio until tc + tail (L): adelay / afade on overlapping tracks; amix.

transitions.name: crossfade-dissolve
transitions.description: A fades out while B fades in over it.
transitions.when_to_use: Passage of time, change of location, montage, calm pace. Avoid in hype edits.
transitions.implementation: ctx.globalAlpha=1; A(ctx,t); ctx.globalAlpha=e; ctx.drawImage(cB,0,0); ctx.globalAlpha=1;

transitions.name: dip-to-color
transitions.description: A fades to black or white, then B fades up.
transitions.when_to_use: Chapter breaks, act breaks in trailers, endings.
transitions.implementation: p<0.5 ? (A(); fill(color, alpha=e(p*2))) : (B(); fill(color, alpha=1-e((p-0.5)*2)))

transitions.name: fade-through
transitions.description: Material pattern: A fades out first, then B fades in while scaling 92% -> 100%.
transitions.when_to_use: Switching between unrelated UI states (tabs, top-level destinations). Material duration ~300 ms.
transitions.implementation: p<0.35 ? (alpha=1-p/0.35, A()) : (alpha=e((p-0.35)/0.65); s=0.92+0.08*alpha; ctx.translate(W/2,H/2); ctx.scale(s,s); ctx.translate(-W/2,-H/2); ctx.globalAlpha=alpha; ctx.drawImage(cB,0,0))

transitions.name: shared-axis
transitions.description: A and B slide together along x, y or z (scale) with a crossfade; strong spatial relationship.
transitions.when_to_use: Forward/back navigation, step-by-step flows, onboarding sequences.
transitions.implementation: x-axis: dx=30*e; A at translate(-dx) alpha 1-e; B at translate(30-dx) alpha e. z-axis: A scale 1->1.1 fade out, B scale 0.8->1 fade in.

transitions.name: push
transitions.description: B pushes A out of frame in one direction; both move together.
transitions.when_to_use: Sequential content, carousels, 'next' beats. Remotion calls it slide().
transitions.implementation: x=W*e; ctx.save(); ctx.translate(-x,0); ctx.drawImage(cA,0,0); ctx.translate(W,0); ctx.drawImage(cB,0,0); ctx.restore();

transitions.name: slide-over
transitions.description: B slides in over a stationary (optionally dimmed and scaled-down) A.
transitions.when_to_use: Modal/sheet reveals, stacking context, iOS-style navigation with parallax.
transitions.implementation: A drawn at translate(-0.3*W*e) with dark overlay alpha 0.3*e; B at translate(W*(1-e)) with shadowBlur=40.

transitions.name: linear-wipe
transitions.description: Hard or soft edge sweeps across, revealing B.
transitions.when_to_use: Classic broadcast; clean section changes; directional storytelling.
transitions.implementation: A(); ctx.save(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(0,0,W*e,H); ctx.clip(); ctx.drawImage(cB,0,0); ctx.restore();  // soft edge: createLinearGradient mask in offscreen with 'destination-in'

transitions.name: diagonal-wipe
transitions.description: Wipe along a slanted edge.
transitions.when_to_use: Sporty, energetic, adds direction without full push.
transitions.implementation: edge x0 = lerp(-H, W, e): path moveTo(x0,0) lineTo(x0+H*tan(a)... ) -> polygon (−H,0),(x0,0),(x0−H*0.4,H),(−H,H); clip; draw cB.

transitions.name: clock-wipe
transitions.description: Radial sweep around the center like a clock hand.
transitions.when_to_use: Time, countdowns, cyclical processes. Remotion ships clockWipe().
transitions.implementation: ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx,cy); ctx.arc(cx,cy,hypot(W,H), -PI/2, -PI/2 + TAU*e); ctx.closePath(); ctx.clip(); draw cB.

transitions.name: iris-circle-wipe
transitions.description: Circle grows from a point (often the clicked element) to reveal B; or closes on A.
transitions.when_to_use: Focus pulls, 'zoom into this feature', endings (iris out). Already in skill as circle wipe.
transitions.implementation: r = e*hypot(max(cx,W-cx), max(cy,H-cy)); ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,0,TAU); ctx.clip(); draw cB.

transitions.name: shape-wipe
transitions.description: Any shape (star, logo glyph, rounded rect, heart) scales up to reveal B.
transitions.when_to_use: Brand moments; playful styles; the shape carries meaning.
transitions.implementation: const p2d=new Path2D(svgD); ctx.translate(cx,cy); ctx.scale(s,s) with s=e*sMax; ctx.rotate(0.3*(1-e)); ctx.clip(p2d); draw cB with inverse transform.

transitions.name: blinds-venetian
transitions.description: N horizontal or vertical slats each open (scaleY 0->1) with a stagger.
transitions.when_to_use: Retro, editorial, staged reveals; works with striped styles.
transitions.implementation: for i<N: pi=clamp((p - i*st)/(1-(N-1)*st)); h=H/N; ctx.rect(0, i*h + h*(1-ease(pi))/2, W, h*ease(pi)); then clip once and draw cB.

transitions.name: stripes-wipe
transitions.description: Colored bars sweep across in staggered order, covering A, then retract to show B.
transitions.when_to_use: Brand color moments, hype, sports intros, kinetic-swiss.
transitions.implementation: bars i<N, color palette[i%n]; cover phase p<0.5: x_i = W*ease(clamp(2p - i*st)); reveal phase: bars slide out the other side; switch A->B at p=0.5 under full cover.

transitions.name: split-reveal
transitions.description: A splits down the middle (or along text baseline) and the halves slide apart revealing B.
transitions.when_to_use: Product unveil, 'opening the box', title to content.
transitions.implementation: B(); left half: clip rect(0,0,W/2,H) translate(-W/2*e) draw cA; right half: clip rect(W/2,0,W/2,H) translate(W/2*e) draw cA.

transitions.name: whip-pan
transitions.description: Very fast pan with heavy directional motion blur; cut hidden inside the blur.
transitions.when_to_use: Energetic scene changes, 'meanwhile', social edits.
transitions.implementation: x = W*easeInOutExpo(p) across concatenated [A|B] strip; motion blur: draw strip N=12 times at x - v*dt*i/N with globalAlpha=1/N (v from derivative); cheaper: draw once with ctx.filter=`blur(${k*v}px)` (isotropic, acceptable at 30 fps).

transitions.name: zoom-through
transitions.description: Camera zooms into a detail of A until it fills the frame and becomes B (infinite zoom).
transitions.when_to_use: Drilling into detail, 'inside the product', continuous worlds. School of Motion 'dynamic/infinite zoom'.
transitions.implementation: s = exp(lerp(0, ln(S), easeInCubic(p))); ctx.translate(fx,fy); ctx.scale(s,s); ctx.translate(-fx,-fy); draw cA; crossfade in cB (drawn at scale s/S) when s > S*0.6.

transitions.name: zoom-blur-punch
transitions.description: Quick scale-in with radial blur and flash into B.
transitions.when_to_use: Hype, beat drops. Remotion: zoomBlur()/dreamyZoom().
transitions.implementation: Draw cA k=8 times at scale 1+0.04*i*e with alpha 1/k (radial blur approximation), then cut to B scaled 1.15->1 with spring snappy.

transitions.name: dolly-zoom-transition
transitions.description: Background scale changes opposite to foreground (vertigo) during the switch.
transitions.when_to_use: Realization moments, dramatic reveals; use rarely.
transitions.implementation: Layers: bg scale sb=1+0.5*e, fg scale sf=1/(1+0.5*e)*k so fg size stays constant; at p=0.5 swap bg A->B under crossfade.

transitions.name: container-morph
transitions.description: One rounded rect morphs position/size/radius from A's element into B's frame, content crossfades with blur.
transitions.when_to_use: Card -> detail, button -> modal; strongest element relationship (Material container transform). Already in skill.
transitions.implementation: rect = lerpRect(r0, r1, e); radius = lerp(r0.rad, r1.rad, e); ctx.roundRect(...); ctx.clip(); A content alpha 1-e*2 blur(8*e); B content alpha (e-0.3)/0.7 blur(8*(1-e)).

transitions.name: text-mask-reveal
transitions.description: B is visible only inside giant type, which then scales up until the letters fill the frame.
transitions.when_to_use: Title openers, campaign words, brand names as windows.
transitions.implementation: off canvas: fillText(word) large; ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-in'; drawImage(cB). On main: A(); ctx.translate(fx,fy); scale(lerp(1,40,easeInExpo(p))); drawImage(off). Final frames: plain cB.

transitions.name: ink-liquid-bleed
transitions.description: Organic blob edge spreads across the frame, revealing B.
transitions.when_to_use: Editorial, ink-wash, organic styles, calm-to-medium energy.
transitions.implementation: Path: circle of N=64 points, radius r(theta) = R*e*(1 + 0.25*noise2(cos(theta)*1.5, sin(theta)*1.5 + t*0.5)); smooth with quadraticCurveTo; clip; draw cB. Optional 2-3 satellite blobs.

transitions.name: page-turn
transitions.description: A curls away like a page revealing B underneath (2D fake).
transitions.when_to_use: Editorial, paper, storybook, before/after.
transitions.implementation: fold line x_f = W*(1-e); clip A to x < x_f; draw flipped strip: ctx.save(); translate(2*x_f,0); scale(-1,1); clip region width w=(W-x_f)*0.5 with linear gradient shading ('multiply'); B underneath. Add shadow gradient along fold.

transitions.name: pixel-dissolve
transitions.description: Random blocks switch from A to B in seeded order.
transitions.when_to_use: Retro, 8-bit, tech, glitch-lite.
transitions.implementation: cell=24; for each cell i: if (hash(i,seed) < e) drawImage(cB, sx,sy,cell,cell, sx,sy,cell,cell) over A.

transitions.name: dither-dissolve
transitions.description: Ordered (Bayer 4x4/8x8) threshold dissolve between A and B.
transitions.when_to_use: Pixel art, terminal-mono, risograph, 1-bit looks.
transitions.implementation: Precompute Bayer matrix M; per pixel block (2-4 px) show B if M[x%8][y%8]/64 < e; build mask in ImageData once per frame, apply via 'destination-in' on cB copy.

transitions.name: mosaic-pixelate
transitions.description: A pixelates to big blocks, swaps to B, then de-pixelates.
transitions.when_to_use: Tech reveals, censoring jokes, glitch transitions.
transitions.implementation: block = lerp(1, 64, tri(p)); ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false; draw src (A if p<0.5 else B) to tiny canvas W/block x H/block, then drawImage back up to W x H.

transitions.name: glitch-rgb-split
transitions.description: Short burst of RGB channel offsets, slice displacement and noise; cut hides inside.
transitions.when_to_use: Tech, cyber, hype; 1-2 per video at most.
transitions.implementation: For 6-10 frames: draw src 3x with 'lighter' and channel tint (or ctx.filter per channel via offscreen multiply with #f00/#0f0/#00f) at x offsets ±(8*hash(frame)); slice: for k slices, drawImage(src,0,y,W,h, dx=±40*hash(frame,k),y,W,h).

transitions.name: light-leak-flash
transitions.description: Warm gradient blob washes across with 'screen' blend, peaking at the cut.
transitions.when_to_use: Lifestyle, nostalgic, product films with film texture.
transitions.implementation: Cut A->B at p=0.5; ctx.globalCompositeOperation='screen'; radial gradients (orange #ff8a3d, magenta #ff3d7f) at center moving x=lerp(-0.2W,1.2W,p), alpha = sin(PI*p).

transitions.name: film-burn
transitions.description: Overexposed hot spot blooms from an edge to white, then B emerges.
transitions.when_to_use: Retro, documentary, analog styles.
transitions.implementation: noise-shaped radial gradient #fff6d0 -> #ff7a00 -> transparent, radius grows with easeInExpo(p); composite 'lighter'; switch to B at peak; fade the burn out over 0.3 s.

transitions.name: luma-fade
transitions.description: B appears through A's brightness: bright areas of A transition first (luma matte).
transitions.when_to_use: Dreamy, photographic, product glints.
transitions.implementation: Get A luminance via getImageData (or pre-baked luma canvas); mask = smoothstep(e-0.1, e+0.1, luma); apply as alpha to cB with 'destination-in' via ImageData write.

transitions.name: spin
transitions.description: A rotates and scales out while B rotates in from the opposite angle.
transitions.when_to_use: Playful, mascot-pop, quick energetic changes.
transitions.implementation: A: translate(center) rotate(PI*e) scale(1-e) alpha 1-e; B: rotate(-PI*(1-e)) scale(e) with playful spring.

transitions.name: card-flip
transitions.description: Scene flips like a card around the Y axis (2D fake via scaleX).
transitions.when_to_use: Reveals, before/after, quiz answers. Remotion: flip().
transitions.implementation: a = PI*e; sx = Math.cos(a); ctx.translate(W/2,0); ctx.scale(Math.abs(sx), 1 - 0.05*Math.sin(a)); draw (a<PI/2 ? cA : cB) centered; darken with fill alpha 0.3*sin(a).

transitions.name: deck-shuffle
transitions.description: A slides off as a card on top of a stack, revealing B as the next card; slight rotation per card.
transitions.when_to_use: Lists of features, testimonials, multiple screens.
transitions.implementation: Stack k cards with offsets (k*8px, rotate(hash(k)*0.06-0.03)); top card A: translate(W*1.2*e, -60*e) rotate(0.2*e); B card rises to top: scale lerp(0.95,1,e).

transitions.name: accordion-fold
transitions.description: A folds into N vertical panels (zig-zag) and collapses; B unfolds.
transitions.when_to_use: Brochures, menus, editorial or retro styles.
transitions.implementation: panel width w=W/N; each panel i drawn via drawImage slice with scaleX = cos(e*PI/2), alternate shading gradient (i%2?darken:lighten); panels packed toward left as they compress.

transitions.name: grid-tile-flip
transitions.description: Screen splits into a grid; each tile flips (scaleX) from A to B with a diagonal stagger.
transitions.when_to_use: Tech dashboards, galleries, departures-board styles.
transitions.implementation: tile (i,j): pi = clamp((p - (i+j)*st)/(1-maxSt)); sx=cos(PI*pi); drawImage((pi<0.5?cA:cB), tile src rect, centered with scaleX |sx|).

transitions.name: scale-through-object
transitions.description: Camera flies into an object in A (a screen, a window, a letter O) which becomes B's frame.
transitions.when_to_use: Device -> app UI, 'inside the dashboard', product to feature.
transitions.implementation: Compute transform that maps object's rect R to full frame: s = W/R.w; T = lerp(identity, scaleAbout(R.center, s), easeInOutCubic(p)); draw cA with T; draw cB inside R (transformed) so at p=1 it fills the frame.

transitions.name: portal-shape
transitions.description: A shape (door, phone outline, circle) in A opens, and B is seen through it, then the shape expands.
transitions.when_to_use: Story worlds, 'step into', app reveals.
transitions.implementation: phase1: B clipped to shape at small size (shape 'opens' via scaleY spring); phase2: scale shape up as iris; add inner shadow (strokeStyle rgba(0,0,0,.4), lineWidth 20, shadowBlur 30).

transitions.name: swipe-up-social
transitions.description: Vertical push mimicking a feed swipe, with slight overshoot.
transitions.when_to_use: 9:16 content, 'next tip' beats, creator-style edits.
transitions.implementation: y = H*spring(t-t0, 320, 30); translate(0,-y) draw cA; translate(0,H-y) draw cB; draw a faint finger/touch dot moving up in the first 0.2 s for affordance.

transitions.name: radial-wipe-burst
transitions.description: Several concentric rings in brand colors expand, last one reveals B.
transitions.when_to_use: Celebrations, logo moments, festive (avoid generic confetti).
transitions.implementation: for i<3: r_i = e_i*R with stagger 0.08; fill circle palette[i]; final ring uses clip to draw cB.

transitions.name: chromatic-slide
transitions.description: Push transition where RGB channels arrive at slightly different times.
transitions.when_to_use: Tech, neon-night, music-driven edits.
transitions.implementation: draw B three times with 'lighter' composite tinted r/g/b, each with x offset W*(1-spring(t-t0-i*0.02, 320,30)); A pushed out normally.

transitions.name: morph-shape-to-shape
transitions.description: Path interpolation between matching point sets (circle -> square -> logo).
transitions.when_to_use: Abstract explainers, icon changes, logo intros.
transitions.implementation: Resample both paths to N=128 points (arc-length), align start index by minimal distance; pts[i] = lerp(a[i], b[i], e); draw with lineTo; fill color lerp.

transitions.name: slit-scan-stretch
transitions.description: A smears horizontally into streaks (pixel row stretch) and B pulls in from the streak.
transitions.when_to_use: Sci-fi, speed, music videos.
transitions.implementation: Take column x_s = lerp(W/2,W,e); drawImage(cA, x_s,0,1,H, x_s,0,W-x_s,H) stretches one column; mirror for B entering.

transitions.name: blur-crossfade
transitions.description: Dissolve where both scenes blur toward the midpoint.
transitions.when_to_use: Soft, premium, calm; hides content mismatch. Already used inside container morph.
transitions.implementation: ctx.filter=`blur(${12*tri(p)}px)`; draw cA alpha 1-e; draw cB alpha e; ctx.filter='none'.

text.name: rise-from-mask
text.description: Each unit slides up from below a clipping line (baseline mask).
text.duration_stagger: 0.6-0.9 s per unit; stagger lines 0.08 s, words 0.06 s, chars 0.008-0.02 s (Codrops/GSAP guidance)
text.implementation: for unit i: e=spring(t-t0-i*st, 220,28); ctx.save(); ctx.rect(x, y-asc, w, asc+desc); ctx.clip(); ctx.fillText(u, x, y + (1-e)*lineH*1.1); ctx.restore();

text.name: fade-up-stagger
text.description: Units fade in while moving up 12-24 px.
text.implementation: e=easeOutCubic(pi); ctx.globalAlpha=e; ctx.fillText(w, x, y + 20*(1-e));

text.name: typewriter-cursor
text.description: Chars appear one by one with a blinking block/bar cursor.
text.duration_stagger: 12-25 chars/s; cursor blink period 1.0 s (on 0.5 / off 0.5)
text.implementation: n=floor((t-t0)*cps); s=str.slice(0,n); fillText(s); cx = x+measureText(s).width; if (n<len || floor(t*2)%2==0) fillRect(cx+2, y-asc, 3, asc);

text.name: typewriter-delete-retype
text.description: Types a phrase, backspaces to a stem, types a replacement.
text.duration_stagger: type 18 cps, hold 0.6 s, delete 35 cps, retype 18 cps
text.implementation: Timeline segments [type A][hold][delete to common prefix][type B]; n(t) piecewise-linear; same cursor logic.

text.name: scramble-decode
text.description: Each char cycles random glyphs before locking to the real one, left to right.
text.duration_stagger: total 0.8-1.4 s; char i locks at t0 + i*0.03 + 0.3
text.implementation: for i: if t < lock_i: ch = GLYPHS[floor(hash(i, floor(t*30))*GLYPHS.length)] else ch=str[i]; use monospace or measure per char; locked chars in full color, scrambling chars at 50% alpha.

text.name: counter-roll
text.description: Number counts from a to b with easing; thousands separators stable.
text.implementation: v = lerp(a, b, easeOutExpo(p)); txt = Intl.NumberFormat('nb-NO').format(round(v)); use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric not on canvas: choose a font with tabular digits or draw each digit in fixed-width cells).

text.name: slot-machine-roll
text.description: Each digit is a vertical strip 0-9 that rolls and lands with overshoot; digits stagger right to left.
text.implementation: per digit d: pos = target_d + 10*(spins) ; y = -(spring(t-t0-i*st,120,22)*pos % 10)*lineH; clip to cell; for k in -1..1 fillText(((floor(-y/lineH)+k)%10), x, y + k*lineH).

text.name: letter-scale-pop
text.description: Chars scale from 0 with overshoot, staggered.
text.duration_stagger: 0.4 s each, stagger 0.03 s, spring playful
text.implementation: s=spring(t-t0-i*0.03, 260, 14); ctx.translate(cx_i, baseline - capH/2); ctx.scale(s,s); fillText(ch, -w/2, capH/2).

text.name: blur-in
text.description: Units go from blur(16px)+alpha 0 to sharp.
text.implementation: ctx.filter=`blur(${16*(1-e)}px)`; ctx.globalAlpha=e; fillText(...); ctx.filter='none';

text.name: tracking-expand
text.description: Letter-spacing grows from tight to wide while fading in (cinematic title).
text.implementation: ctx.letterSpacing = `${lerp(-0.05, 0.3, e)}em`; (Chrome canvas supports letterSpacing) else lay out chars manually x_i += w_i + spacing; ctx.textAlign center by measuring total width.

text.name: highlight-marker-sweep
text.description: A marker-colored rect sweeps behind a word left to right.
text.duration_stagger: 0.4-0.6 s, start after the word is readable
text.implementation: fillStyle=markerColor; fillRect(x, y-capH*0.9, w*e, capH*1.15) with slight skew: ctx.transform(1,0,-0.1,1,0,0); then fillText on top. Rough edge: polygon with hash-jittered vertices.

text.name: underline-draw
text.description: Line or hand-drawn swoosh draws under a word.
text.implementation: ctx.setLineDash([len,len]); ctx.lineDashOffset = len*(1-e); ctx.stroke(underlinePath2D); ctx.lineCap='round'.

text.name: strike-through
text.description: Line crosses out a word; optional replacement appears above.
text.implementation: moveTo(x, yMid); lineTo(x + w*e, yMid + jitter); stroke; old word alpha -> 0.5; new word via rise-from-mask above.

text.name: kinetic-stack-push
text.description: Each new line enters at the bottom and pushes the stack up; older lines shrink/fade.
text.implementation: stackOffset = sum over pushes j of lineH*spring(t - tj, 320, 30); line k drawn at y0 - (k*lineH) + ... ; alpha = 1 - 0.25*age.

text.name: word-swap-carousel
text.description: One slot in a sentence cycles words vertically ('Built for [teams|speed|you]').
text.duration_stagger: hold 1.2-1.8 s per word, swap 0.35 s
text.implementation: slotW = lerp(w_prev, w_next, e) so the sentence reflows; clip slot rect; prev at y - lineH*e alpha 1-e, next at y + lineH*(1-e) alpha e.

text.name: split-flap-board
text.description: Each char flips through characters like an airport board until it lands.
text.duration_stagger: per flip 0.06 s; total 0.6-1.5 s; stagger 0.02 s
text.implementation: seq = charset from current to target; idx=floor((t-ti)/0.06); top half: old char clipped to upper half; flipping flap: scaleY = cos(PI*f) of new/old half; bottom half new char; dark gap line at middle; tile bg #111, text #f2f2f2.

text.name: handwriting-stroke
text.description: Text appears as if written by pen along its strokes.
text.implementation: Use a single-line (stroke) font path set as Path2D list (e.g. Hershey or exported from a script font via opentype.js); for each path k with length L_k, reveal sequentially with setLineDash([L,L]) + lineDashOffset = L*(1-pk).

text.name: outline-to-fill
text.description: Text first draws as outline, then fills.
text.implementation: Stroke phase: strokeText with dash (needs glyph path via opentype.js) or approximate: clip rect growing over strokeText. Fill phase: globalAlpha=e2; fillText.

text.name: gradient-sweep
text.description: A shine or color gradient moves across the letters.
text.duration_stagger: 0.8-1.2 s, once or loop every 3 s
text.implementation: g = createLinearGradient(x0 + sweep, 0, x0 + sweep + 200, 0) with base, highlight, base stops; sweep = lerp(-200, w, p); fillStyle=g; fillText.

text.name: bounce-drop
text.description: Chars fall from above and bounce on the baseline.
text.implementation: y = baseline - dropH*(1-easeOutBounce(pi)); or spring(t, 260, 14) for elastic landing.

text.name: wave-sine
text.description: Chars bob on a traveling sine wave.
text.implementation: y_i = baseline + A*sin(TAU*(t/period) - i*0.4); entry: A *= e.

text.name: elastic-stretch
text.description: Word squashes and stretches on entry (scaleX/scaleY inverse), then settles.
text.implementation: s=spring(t-t0,260,14); sy = s; sx = 1 + (1 - s)*0.6; translate(center); scale(sx, sy); fillText.

text.name: caption-karaoke
text.description: Burned-in captions; current word highlighted (color/scale/pill) in sync with speech.
text.duration_stagger: per word timing from transcript (whisper word timestamps); 2-7 words per caption page
text.implementation: page = words grouped to <= 32 chars; active word = words where w.start <= t < w.end; draw pill roundRect behind active word with spring ui on enter; others at 70% alpha.

text.name: quote-reveal
text.description: Pull quote: big quotation mark draws, text rises by line, attribution fades last.
text.duration_stagger: quote mark 0.4 s, lines 0.08 s stagger, attribution +0.4 s
text.implementation: quote glyph scale pop (spring ui); rise-from-mask per line; attribution fade-up; hold based on reading speed.

text.name: big-number-slam
text.description: Huge number scales down from 3x to 1x with impact shake and a flash.
text.implementation: s = 1 + 2*(1-spring(t-t0, 320, 30)); camera shake amplitude 14*exp(-(t-t0-0.2)*12); 1-frame white flash at impact; optional unit/label rises after.

text.name: lower-third
text.description: Name/title bar: accent line draws, plate slides out, name and role rise.
text.duration_stagger: in 0.6 s, hold 3-5 s, out 0.4 s
text.implementation: accent bar width = 6 -> plateW via spring ui; plate clipRect grows; name rise-from-mask; role fade-up delayed 0.1 s; out = reverse with easeInCubic.

text.name: ticker-marquee
text.description: Text scrolls continuously across a band.
text.implementation: x = -((t*speed) % (textW + gap)); for (k=0; x + k*(textW+gap) < W; k++) fillText(str, x + k*(textW+gap), y).

text.name: word-cloud-assemble
text.description: Words fly in from scattered positions to a packed layout.
text.duration_stagger: 1.2-2 s total, stagger by size (largest first)
text.implementation: precompute final positions (spiral packing, seeded); start = final + polar(400+hash*400, hash*TAU); pos = lerp(start, final, spring(t-t0-i*st, 220,28)); rotate lerp(hash*0.6-0.3, 0).

text.name: line-by-line-wipe
text.description: Each line revealed by a left-to-right clip wipe.
text.implementation: clip rect(x, y-asc, w*e_i, lineH); fillText.

text.name: char-cascade-3d
text.description: Chars rotate in on X axis (fake with scaleY + skew) like falling dominos.
text.implementation: a=(1-e)*PI/2; ctx.translate(cx, baseline); ctx.transform(1, 0, 0, cos(a), 0, 0); alpha = e; fillText(ch, -w/2, 0).

text.name: weight-morph
text.description: Variable-font weight animates (Thin -> Black) on emphasis.
text.implementation: Canvas font string accepts numeric weight with variable fonts: ctx.font=`${round(lerp(200,900,e))} 120px 'Inter'`; load font via FontFace first; re-measure for centering each frame.

text.name: text-on-path
text.description: Text runs along a curved path, path offset animates.
text.implementation: precompute path samples with arc length; for char i at s = offset + cumW_i: pos, angle = sample(s); translate(pos) rotate(angle) fillText(ch,0,0).

text.name: glitch-text
text.description: Text jitters with RGB offset and slice displacement for a few frames, then settles.
text.implementation: for 3 passes with 'lighter' and fill #f0f/#0ff/#fff: fillText(x + (hash(frame,c)-0.5)*12); slice: clip random horizontal bands and offset x.

text.name: mask-wipe-color-swap
text.description: Text changes color with a hard wipe passing through it (two-tone).
text.implementation: fillText(colorA); clip rect(x, y, w*e, h); fillText(colorB).

text.name: countdown-flip
text.description: 3-2-1 numerals with scale-down + fade, each on a beat.
text.implementation: for n: tn = t0 + k*beat; s = lerp(1.4, 1, easeOutCubic); alpha 1 -> 0 over last 30% of beat.

text.name: emoji-react-pop
text.description: Emoji or icon pops next to a word (opt-in, social only).
text.implementation: drawImage(emojiBitmap) with letter-scale-pop math, rotation 0.3*(1-s).

camera.name: push-in
camera.description: Slow scale toward a focus point; adds tension or attention.
camera.implementation: s = lerp(1, 1.12, e); ctx.translate(fx,fy); ctx.scale(s,s); ctx.translate(-fx,-fy); drawWorld(). Slow: 3-8 s linear-ish (easeInOutSine).

camera.name: pull-out
camera.description: Reverse push; reveals context or ends a scene.
camera.implementation: s = lerp(1.25, 1, e) about focus; often combined with fading in surrounding UI.

camera.name: pan
camera.description: Horizontal move across a wide world.
camera.implementation: ctx.translate(-lerp(x0, x1, e), 0); world drawn wider than W. Keep speed < W/3 per s to avoid judder at 30 fps.

camera.name: tilt
camera.description: Vertical move (scroll down a page, top to bottom of a building).
camera.implementation: ctx.translate(0, -lerp(y0, y1, e)). For UI scroll demos, use spring ui per scroll step.

camera.name: truck-parallax
camera.description: Camera moves sideways; layers move at speeds proportional to 1/depth.
camera.implementation: for layer L with depth z: ctx.save(); ctx.translate(-camX / z, -camY / z); L.draw(); ctx.restore(); z=1 foreground, 2-6 background.

camera.name: parallax-layers-drift
camera.description: Static shot made alive by small layered drift.
camera.implementation: camX = 30*sin(t*0.2); camY = 10*sin(t*0.13); apply truck-parallax with z in [1, 1.5, 3].

camera.name: orbit-2_5d
camera.description: Fake orbit around a subject using layer x-offsets by depth and slight scaleX.
camera.implementation: angle a = lerp(-0.3, 0.3, e); for layer z: x = sin(a)*R*(1/z - 1/zFocus); scaleX = cos(a*0.5) for flat cards; sort by depth each frame.

camera.name: seeded-shake
camera.implementation: amp = A*exp(-(t-ti)*decay); dx = amp*(noise1(t*25, seed)-0.5)*2; dy = amp*(noise1(t*25, seed+7)-0.5)*2; rot = amp*0.002*(noise1(t*25, seed+13)-0.5); A=12 px, decay 8-12.

camera.name: handheld-drift
camera.description: Low-frequency wander that mimics a handheld camera.
camera.implementation: dx = 6*noise1(t*0.7, s1)+2*noise1(t*2.1, s2); dy similarly; rot = 0.003*noise1(t*0.5, s3); scale 1.03 to hide edges.

camera.name: rack-focus
camera.description: Blur moves from one depth layer to another.
camera.implementation: f = e; fg.filter = blur(8*f px); bg.filter = blur(8*(1-f) px); draw bg then fg. Pre-blur on offscreen for speed.

camera.name: dolly-zoom
camera.description: Subject stays the same size while the background scale changes (vertigo effect).
camera.implementation: bgScale = lerp(1, 1.6, e); fgScale = constant (or slight compensating 1/lerp(1,1.05,e)); draw bg about vanishing point, then fg.

camera.name: snap-zoom
camera.description: Very fast zoom (0.15-0.3 s) to a detail, often with whoosh SFX.
camera.implementation: s = lerp(1, 2.2, spring(t-t0, 320, 30)) about target; add 3-frame directional blur (draw 4 copies at intermediate scales, alpha 0.25).

camera.name: whip-pan-camera
camera.description: Extremely fast pan with motion blur between two framings in the same world.
camera.implementation: x = lerp(x0, x1, easeInOutExpo(p)); v = dx/dt; draw N=10 copies at x - v*(i/N)*shutter with alpha 1/N; shutter = 1/fps*0.5.

camera.name: follow-cursor
camera.description: Camera loosely follows the cursor/point of interest with lag.
camera.implementation: Closed-form: cam(t) = target(t) convolved with spring; practical: cam = sum over target keyframes j of (pos_j - pos_{j-1})*spring(t - t_j, 90, 19); keeps purity.

camera.name: crane-pedestal
camera.description: Vertical rise revealing a scene from below/above with slight scale change.
camera.implementation: y = lerp(200, 0, e); s = lerp(1.05, 1, e); combine with parallax layers.

camera.name: dutch-roll
camera.description: Small rotation for unease or energy.
camera.implementation: ctx.translate(W/2,H/2); ctx.rotate(lerp(0, 0.06, e)); ctx.translate(-W/2,-H/2). Keep <= 5 deg; scale 1.08 to hide corners.

camera.name: focus-zoom-to-rect
camera.description: Zoom so a given UI rect fills ~70% of the frame (product demo staple).
camera.implementation: s = 0.7*min(W/R.w, H/R.h); target translation centers R; T = lerp(identity, (scale s about R.center then recenter), spring(t-t0, 90, 19)).

camera.name: ken-burns
camera.description: Slow pan + zoom across a still image.
camera.implementation: s = lerp(1.0, 1.15, p); offset = lerp(o0, o1, p); linear or easeInOutSine over 5-10 s.

backgrounds.name: film-grain
backgrounds.description: Seeded per-frame monochrome noise overlay. Already in skill.
backgrounds.implementation: Pre-generate 8 noise tiles (256x256 ImageData, seeded); per frame pick tile floor(hash(frame)*8), random offset; ctx.globalCompositeOperation='overlay'; alpha 0.06-0.12; createPattern.

backgrounds.name: scanlines
backgrounds.description: Horizontal dark lines every 2-4 px.
backgrounds.implementation: pattern canvas 1x3: row 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25); ctx.fillStyle=ctx.createPattern(pat,'repeat'); fillRect; optional slow roll: translate(0, (t*20)%3).

backgrounds.name: dot-grid
backgrounds.description: Regular dots, can pulse or fade toward edges.
backgrounds.implementation: for x in 0..W step g, y step g: r = 1.5 * (1 + 0.3*sin(t*2 + (x+y)*0.01)); arc; fill rgba(...). Use a pattern for static version.

backgrounds.name: line-grid
backgrounds.description: Thin graph-paper grid, optionally drifting.
backgrounds.implementation: ctx.lineWidth=1; stroke vertical/horizontal lines at offset (t*speed) % g; major lines every 5 at higher alpha.

backgrounds.name: blueprint
backgrounds.description: Cyan-white grid on deep blue with dimension lines and annotations.
backgrounds.implementation: fill #0b3a6e; minor grid rgba(255,255,255,.08) 20px; major .18 100px; dimension lines with arrowheads and monospace labels drawn via line-draw (lineDash).

backgrounds.name: animated-gradient-mesh
backgrounds.description: Soft blobs of color moving slowly, blurred.
backgrounds.implementation: 4-5 radial gradients, centers c_i = base_i + 120*[noise1(t*0.1, i), noise1(t*0.1, i+9)]; composite 'lighter' or normal on base; optional ctx.filter='blur(60px)' on a half-res offscreen then upscale.

backgrounds.name: noise-flow-field
backgrounds.description: Particles trace curl/noise flow lines (precomputed paths for purity).
backgrounds.implementation: Seed N=800 particles; position at t found by integrating a fixed number of steps k=floor(t*fps) is expensive, so precompute trajectories once at load (array per particle), then at t draw the trailing segment indices [k-20, k] with alpha falloff.

backgrounds.name: halftone
backgrounds.description: Dot screen whose dot radius encodes brightness of an underlying image/gradient.
backgrounds.implementation: grid at 45 deg: ctx.rotate(PI/4); for cell: lum = sample(src, x, y); r = cell*0.5*sqrt(1-lum); arc fill. Animate lum source for moving halftone.

backgrounds.name: risograph-misregistration
backgrounds.description: Two or three flat ink layers slightly offset, with grain and multiply blend.
backgrounds.implementation: draw layer in pink #ff48b0 and layer in blue #0078bf separately onto offscreens; composite with 'multiply'; offset each by (2-4 px)*(hash(floor(t*4), layer)-0.5) (steps, not smooth); add coarse grain mask via 'destination-out'.

backgrounds.name: paper-fibers
backgrounds.description: Warm paper with subtle fibers and tooth.
backgrounds.implementation: base #f4efe6; seeded 400 short bezier strokes rgba(120,100,70,.05) length 10-40 px; low-freq noise blotches (radial gradients alpha .03); static, render once to offscreen.

backgrounds.name: starfield
backgrounds.description: Stars with parallax depth and twinkle; optional warp.
backgrounds.implementation: stars i: (x,y,z) from hash; screen x = cx + (x - cx)/z*f; z(t) = z0 - t*speed mod depth for warp; twinkle alpha = 0.6 + 0.4*sin(t*3 + hash*TAU).

backgrounds.name: bokeh
backgrounds.description: Out-of-focus light discs drifting.
backgrounds.implementation: N=30 circles radius 20-80, color from palette, alpha 0.08-0.2, 'lighter' composite; positions drift with noise1(t*0.05, i); ring edge via radial gradient with brighter rim.

backgrounds.name: aurora
backgrounds.description: Ribbon-like curtains of green/teal/violet light that undulate.
backgrounds.implementation: for ribbon k: build polyline y(x) = base_k + 60*noise2(x*0.002, t*0.1 + k); fill vertical linearGradient (color -> transparent) below the line; ctx.filter='blur(20px)'; 'screen' composite.

backgrounds.name: topographic-contours
backgrounds.description: Contour lines from a noise height field, slowly morphing.
backgrounds.implementation: Height h(x,y,t) = noise3(x*0.004, y*0.004, t*0.05); marching squares on a 4 px grid for levels 0.1..0.9; stroke each iso-line 1 px. Cache per frame (heavy at 1080p; use 6-8 px grid).

backgrounds.name: isometric-grid
backgrounds.description: Lines at 30/150 deg forming an isometric lattice.
backgrounds.implementation: for k: stroke lines y = x*tan(30deg) + k*g and y = -x*tan(30deg) + k*g; plus verticals for tri-grid; use with isometric-tech style.

backgrounds.name: rain-streaks
backgrounds.description: Diagonal streaks falling. Already in skill.
backgrounds.implementation: per drop i: x = (hash(i)*W + t*vx) % W; y = (hash(i,1)*H + t*vy) % H; stroke line length 20-40 px alpha 0.2-0.4.

backgrounds.name: snow
backgrounds.description: Flakes falling with sway.
backgrounds.implementation: y = (y0 + t*v_i) % (H+20); x = x0 + 20*sin(t*0.8 + phase_i); radius 1-3 by depth; alpha by depth.

backgrounds.name: confetti-burst
backgrounds.description: Paper rectangles burst and fall with spin. Banned by default: generic burst reads as template. Opt-in only for genuine celebration moments with brand colors.
backgrounds.implementation: particle i: v0 from hash; pos = p0 + v0*dt + 0.5*g*dt^2 with drag approx; rotation = w_i*dt; draw rect with scaleY = cos(flip_i*dt) for tumble.

backgrounds.name: light-rays
backgrounds.description: God rays radiating from a point.
backgrounds.implementation: for k<24: angle a_k + 0.05*sin(t*0.3+k); draw thin triangle from source to far point, fill with linearGradient white alpha .08 -> 0, 'screen'.

backgrounds.name: vignette
backgrounds.description: Darkened edges to focus center.
backgrounds.implementation: radial gradient from (W/2,H/2, 0.4*min(W,H)) transparent to (.., 0.75*hypot(W,H)/2) rgba(0,0,0,.45); fillRect last.

backgrounds.name: chromatic-aberration
backgrounds.description: RGB fringing growing toward the edges.
backgrounds.implementation: Draw frame into offscreen; composite three copies with 'lighter' through channel tints (multiply by #f00/#0f0/#00f), scaled 1+0.003*k about center; mild only.

backgrounds.name: crt
backgrounds.description: Curved-feel screen: scanlines, phosphor glow, vignette, slight flicker.
backgrounds.implementation: scanlines + glow (draw content blurred 6px with 'screen' alpha .4) + vignette + flicker alpha 0.97 + 0.03*hash(frame); optional barrel via drawing 40 horizontal slices with x-scale 1 - 0.03*((y-H/2)/(H/2))^2.

backgrounds.name: vhs-tracking
backgrounds.description: Tape artifacts: horizontal jitter bands, color bleed, noise line rolling.
backgrounds.implementation: band y_b = (t*120) % H; within band height 30: drawImage slice offset x by 10*hash(frame); chroma bleed: draw red copy offset +3 px 'screen'; bottom noise line; timestamp overlay in VT323.

backgrounds.name: duotone
backgrounds.description: Image mapped to two colors (shadows -> color A, highlights -> color B).
backgrounds.implementation: draw image; ctx.filter='grayscale(1) contrast(1.2)'; then fill color B with 'multiply', color A with 'lighten' (or per-pixel LUT via ImageData once and cache).

backgrounds.name: ordered-dither
backgrounds.description: 1-bit Bayer dithered gradient or image.
backgrounds.implementation: per pixel block: out = lum > bayer8[x%8][y%8]/64 ? fg : bg; build ImageData once per unique frame of source.

backgrounds.name: concentric-pulse
backgrounds.description: Rings emanate from center (radar, sonar, broadcast).
backgrounds.implementation: for k: r = ((t*speed + k*gap) % maxR); alpha = 1 - r/maxR; stroke circle.

backgrounds.name: stripes-diagonal
backgrounds.description: Moving barber-pole diagonal stripes.
backgrounds.implementation: pattern canvas with two color bands rotated 45 deg; ctx.setTransform via pattern.setTransform(new DOMMatrix().translate(t*40, 0)).

backgrounds.name: bauhaus-shapes
backgrounds.description: Primary geometric shapes (circle, square, triangle) slowly rotating/drifting.
backgrounds.implementation: set of 6 seeded shapes; rotation = w_i*t; position drift small; flat fills from palette, no gradients.

backgrounds.name: caustics
backgrounds.description: Underwater light caustics shimmer.
backgrounds.implementation: layer two noise fields: c = abs(noise3(x*0.01,y*0.01,t*0.4) - noise3(x*0.012+5,y*0.012,t*0.35)); bright where c small; render at 1/4 res, blur, upscale, 'screen'.

ui.name: cursor-arrow
ui.description: macOS-style arrow cursor with white outline and drop shadow; moves along a bezier with spring arrival.
ui.implementation: Path2D arrow (11 pts); fill #000, stroke #fff 1.5px, shadowBlur 6 rgba(0,0,0,.3); pos = bezier(p0, c, p1, spring(t-t0, 220, 28)); slight overshoot is natural.

ui.name: cursor-hand
ui.description: Pointer hand when over clickable elements; swap from arrow on hover.
ui.implementation: if (hoverRect contains pos) draw hand Path2D else arrow; crossfade over 2 frames.

ui.name: touch-dot
ui.description: Semi-transparent circle representing a finger on mobile.
ui.implementation: arc r=22, fill rgba(255,255,255,.35), stroke rgba(0,0,0,.25); on press scale 0.85 (spring snappy); drag leaves fading trail of last 8 positions.

ui.name: cursor-ring
ui.description: Ring cursor (presentation/screencast style) that grows on hover.
ui.implementation: stroke circle r = lerp(10, 18, hoverE), lineWidth 2, brand color; inner dot r 3.

ui.name: click-ripple
ui.description: Expanding, fading ring at click point. Already in skill.
ui.implementation: r = 4 + 36*easeOutCubic(p); alpha = 1 - p; stroke lineWidth = 3*(1-p); dur 0.45 s; cursor scale 0.9 at click.

ui.name: tap-indicator
ui.description: Mobile tap: filled dot that scales in and a ripple ring; long-press shows growing ring.
ui.implementation: dot: scale spring snappy, alpha 0.4; ring: r grows 0->40 over press duration; release: ripple.

ui.name: spotlight-dim-hole
ui.description: Dims everything except a rounded-rect or circle hole around the target.
ui.implementation: ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.6)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(0,0,W,H); ctx.roundRect(hx,hy,hw,hh,r); ctx.fill('evenodd'); hole rect animates from full screen to target via spring ui; alpha fades in 0.3 s.

ui.name: highlight-ring
ui.description: Pulsing outline around an element.
ui.implementation: roundRect(target expanded by 6 + 4*sin(t*4)); stroke brand color lineWidth 3; alpha 0.6 + 0.4*sin(t*4).

ui.name: arrow-callout-drawn
ui.description: Hand-drawn curved arrow draws toward a target with a label.
ui.implementation: Path2D quadratic curve + arrowhead; reveal via setLineDash([L,L]) lineDashOffset L*(1-e); arrowhead appears at e>0.9 with scale pop; label fade-up.

ui.name: tooltip-pop
ui.description: Small bubble with pointer that scales from its anchor.
ui.implementation: ctx.translate(anchor); ctx.scale(s,s) with s = spring(t-t0, 260, 20) from 0.6; alpha e; roundRect + triangle pointer; text 14-18 px.

ui.name: sticky-note
ui.description: Yellow note with slight rotation and shadow; drops on with bounce.
ui.implementation: fill #ffe66d, rotate(-0.04), shadow offsetY 8 blur 16; entry: y from -80 with spring playful, rotation settles from -0.15; handwriting font (Kalam).

ui.name: magnifier-loupe
ui.description: Circular lens that magnifies the content under it.
ui.implementation: draw scene; ctx.save(); ctx.arc(lx,ly,R,0,TAU); ctx.clip(); ctx.translate(lx,ly); ctx.scale(2,2); ctx.translate(-lx,-ly); drawScene(); ctx.restore(); stroke ring lineWidth 6 + handle.

ui.name: browser-chrome-frame
ui.description: Window with traffic-light dots, tab, address bar; content clipped inside.
ui.implementation: roundRect window r=12 fill #fff shadow 40; top bar 40 px #f1f1f1; circles #ff5f57 #febc2e #28c840 r=6; url pill with monospace text; clip content rect. Entry: scale 0.96->1 + fade, spring ui.

ui.name: phone-frame
ui.description: Generic smartphone bezel with rounded screen and dynamic-island pill (no brand marks).
ui.implementation: outer roundRect r=56 fill #111; screen inset 12 px r=44; pill at top 120x34 r=17; clip screen to draw app UI; side-buttons as thin rects.

ui.name: laptop-frame
ui.description: Generic laptop: screen bezel and trapezoid base.
ui.implementation: screen roundRect fill #1b1b1f; base polygon wider than screen with gradient #d9d9de->#bfc0c6; notch optional; content clip to screen.

ui.name: notification-toast
ui.description: Banner slides from top (mobile) or corner (desktop), holds, exits.
ui.implementation: y = lerp(-h-20, 24, spring(t-t0, 320, 30)); roundRect blur-backed (draw bg region blurred via filter inside clip); icon + title + body; exit after 2.5 s with easeInCubic.

ui.name: progress-bar
ui.description: Linear determinate bar with non-linear realistic progress.
ui.implementation: w = W_bar * piecewise(p) with plateaus (e.g. 0->0.4 fast, hold, 0.4->0.9, 1); fill roundRect; optional shimmer gradient moving.

ui.name: spinner-arc
ui.description: Rotating arc whose length breathes (Material-style indeterminate).
ui.implementation: rot = t*TAU*0.8; len = 0.1 + 0.6*(0.5-0.5*cos(t*TAU*0.66)); arc(cx,cy,r, rot, rot + len*TAU); lineCap round.

ui.name: spinner-dots
ui.description: Three dots bouncing in sequence (typing indicator).
ui.implementation: for i<3: y = -6*max(0, sin(TAU*(t*1.4) - i*0.6)); arc r 5.

ui.name: chat-bubbles
ui.description: Messages appear one by one with typing indicator first; list scrolls up.
ui.implementation: for msg i at time ti: typing dots from ti-0.8 to ti; bubble: scale from tail corner, spring ui; previous bubbles y offset by sum of heights*spring; sent = right/brand color, received = left/grey.

ui.name: keycaps
ui.description: Keyboard shortcut keycaps (e.g. Cmd + K) that press down in sync.
ui.implementation: roundRect key with bottom edge darker (two rects offset 4 px); press: translateY 3 px and edge shrinks, spring snappy; '+' between keys; monospace label.

ui.name: before-after-slider
ui.description: Vertical divider sweeps to reveal 'after' over 'before', with handle.
ui.implementation: draw before; clip rect(0,0,x,H) draw after; x = lerp(0.1W, 0.9W, easeInOutSine) with hold; handle circle + line; labels 'Before'/'After' pills.

ui.name: checklist-ticking
ui.description: Items check off in sequence: box fills, checkmark draws, text strikes or dims.
ui.implementation: box roundRect; fill scale pop spring snappy; check Path2D (2 segments) via lineDash reveal 0.25 s; label alpha 1->0.6; stagger 0.35-0.5 s.

ui.name: toggle-switch
ui.description: Pill switch whose knob slides with squash and track color crossfades.
ui.implementation: knobX = lerp(x0, x1, spring(t-t0, 320, 30)); knob width stretches 1.2x mid-way: w = r*2*(1 + 0.2*sin(PI*p)); track color lerpColor(off,on,e).

ui.name: step-indicator
ui.description: Numbered dots connected by a line; progress fills to the current step.
ui.implementation: line fill length = segment*stepE; dots: completed fill brand + check, current ring pulse, upcoming grey; label below each.

ui.name: code-block-typing
ui.description: Editor panel with syntax colors; code types in token by token with cursor.
ui.implementation: pre-tokenize (small regex lexer: keywords, strings, numbers, comments) to [{text,color}]; reveal chars by n(t); draw tokens with measureText advancing x; line numbers gutter; JetBrains Mono.

ui.name: terminal-window
ui.description: Dark terminal with prompt, typed command, then output lines streaming.
ui.implementation: window frame #0d0d0d with title bar; prompt '$ ' green; command typewriter 25 cps; Enter at tc; output lines appear every 40-80 ms (hash-jittered); auto-scroll when y > maxY.

ui.name: form-fill
ui.description: Input field focus ring, typing, validation check.
ui.implementation: border color lerp to brand on focus; placeholder fades; typewriter value; green check pop on blur.

ui.name: modal-dialog
ui.description: Backdrop dims, dialog scales 0.95->1 and fades in.
ui.implementation: backdrop alpha 0.5*e; dialog s = 0.95 + 0.05*spring(t-t0,220,28); y 12*(1-e).

ui.name: drag-and-drop
ui.description: Card lifts (shadow grows, scale 1.03), follows cursor, drops into slot with settle.
ui.implementation: lift: shadowBlur 4->24, scale spring snappy; follow cursor path; drop: pos spring ui into slot; other cards reflow via spring.

ui.name: badge-counter
ui.description: Notification badge pops and number increments.
ui.implementation: circle scale pop spring playful; number via counter-roll in tiny size.

dataviz.name: bar-grow
dataviz.description: Bars grow from baseline with stagger; value labels count up.
dataviz.implementation: h_i = value_i*scale*spring(t-t0-i*0.06, 220, 28); fillRect(x_i, base-h_i, bw, h_i); label = counter-roll with same e; axis draws first via line-draw.

dataviz.name: bar-chart-race
dataviz.description: Ranked horizontal bars reorder over time as values change.
dataviz.implementation: keyframes per period; interpolate values v(t) linearly between periods; rank by v at t; y position = spring-smoothed rank: y = sum_j (rank_j - rank_{j-1})*spring(t - t_j, 220, 28)*rowH; bar width = v*scale; label + value at bar end; period label big in corner.

dataviz.name: line-draw-dot
dataviz.description: Line draws left to right with a leading dot and value label.
dataviz.implementation: Path2D of points; total length L (sum of segments); setLineDash([L,L]); lineDashOffset=L*(1-e); dot at point at arc length L*e (precompute cumulative lengths); label follows dot.

dataviz.name: area-fill
dataviz.description: Area under a line fills after or with the line, gradient to transparent.
dataviz.implementation: clip rect(0,0,x(e),H); fill area path with linearGradient(color alpha .35 -> 0); then line-draw on top.

dataviz.name: donut-sweep
dataviz.description: Donut segments sweep around in sequence.
dataviz.implementation: for seg k: a0=start_k; a1 = start_k + span_k*clamp((e*total - start_k)/span_k); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,a0,a1); lineWidth = R-r; lineCap butt; center label counts to percentage.

dataviz.name: pie-explode
dataviz.description: Pie draws, then one slice pulls out for emphasis.
dataviz.implementation: slice k offset = 24*spring(t-tk,260,20) along mid-angle (cos m, sin m); other slices alpha 0.5.

dataviz.name: big-counter
dataviz.description: Single KPI with label, counts up and settles with a small scale bump.
dataviz.implementation: counter-roll + at end scale 1.06 -> 1 with spring playful; unit suffix rises in after.

dataviz.name: sparkline
dataviz.description: Tiny inline line chart next to a number; last point dot pulses.
dataviz.implementation: line-draw in 0.6 s; end dot r 3 + pulse ring every 1.5 s.

dataviz.name: heatmap-fill
dataviz.description: Grid cells fill with color in a wave (diagonal or by value).
dataviz.implementation: cell (i,j): delay = (i+j)*0.015 (or by value rank); alpha/scale spring ui; color from sequential palette lerp(lo, hi, v).

dataviz.name: map-pin-drop
dataviz.description: Pins drop onto a simplified map and bounce; ripple at impact.
dataviz.implementation: map as Path2D (pre-projected); pin y = target - 80*(1-easeOutBounce(pi)); shadow ellipse scales with height; ripple ring at landing.

dataviz.name: flow-sankey-draw
dataviz.description: Flows draw from source to target as thick bezier bands.
dataviz.implementation: band = two cubic beziers + close; reveal by clip rect growing in x, or draw centerline with lineWidth=flow and lineDash reveal; stagger per flow.

dataviz.name: progress-ring
dataviz.description: Circular progress to a percentage with counter in center.
dataviz.implementation: track circle alpha .15; arc(-PI/2, -PI/2 + TAU*pct*e) lineCap round; counter.

dataviz.name: comparison-split
dataviz.description: Two values side by side, the winner bar extends further and highlights.
dataviz.implementation: both bars grow with same spring; at end, loser fades to grey, winner gets highlight-ring and label slam.

dataviz.name: timeline-scrub
dataviz.description: Horizontal timeline; playhead moves and events pop as it passes.
dataviz.implementation: playhead x = lerp(x0, x1, p); event k visible when x >= x_k: scale pop + label fade-up; past segment colored, future grey.

dataviz.name: scatter-bloom
dataviz.description: Points appear from center or by group, settle to positions.
dataviz.implementation: pos = lerp(center, target, spring(t-t0-hash(i)*0.4, 220, 28)); radius pop.

dataviz.name: waffle-unit-chart
dataviz.description: 10x10 grid of squares fills to a percentage (isotype-like).
dataviz.implementation: cell n < round(pct*100) filled in order with delay n*0.012; scale spring snappy.

dataviz.name: stacked-bar-build
dataviz.description: Segments stack one category at a time.
dataviz.implementation: segment k grows after segment k-1 completes; legend item highlights in sync.

dataviz.name: slope-chart
dataviz.description: Two columns of values connected by lines that draw, rising lines in accent.
dataviz.implementation: line-draw each connector with stagger; endpoint dots pop; color by sign.

dataviz.name: axis-gridline-intro
dataviz.description: Axes draw, ticks fade in, then data animates (staging).
dataviz.implementation: axis line-draw 0.4 s; ticks fade-up stagger 0.02 s; data starts at +0.5 s.

dataviz.name: annotation-on-chart
dataviz.description: Callout line and label pinned to a data point after the data settles.
dataviz.implementation: leader line lineDash reveal from point to label; label rise; point highlight ring.

dataviz.name: number-to-chart-morph
dataviz.description: Big number shrinks and moves to become the top of its bar.
dataviz.implementation: number pos/scale lerp to bar top via spring camera; bar grows beneath simultaneously.

notes: bar_seconds = 240 / BPM (4/4). beat = 60 / BPM. Snap cuts and slams to beats; move text entries a few frames before the beat so they land on it.

Text hold rule (convention derived from reading research): hold_s = 0.5 + words / wps, minimum 1.2 s for any readable line. Brysbaert (2019) measured 238 wpm (~4.0 words/s) average silent reading of non-fiction; moving video with competing visuals reads slower, so presets use 2.0-3.5 wps.

Subtitle ceiling: Netflix guides cap adult subtitles at ~17 characters/s in most languages (some English guidance cites 20 cps), minimum 5/6 s per event, maximum 7 s. Use 15 cps for burned-in captions on busy visuals.
Spring scaling: multiply k by s^2 and d by s to speed motion by factor s while keeping the same overshoot character. The spring_k_mult below is s^2; damping multiplier is sqrt(spring_k_mult).

Film baseline: Hollywood average shot length was ~8-11 s in 1930-1960 and ~3-6 s by ~2000 (Bordwell, Intensified Continuity); Cutting et al. measured the decline across 160 films 1935-2010. These are features, not ads; short-form social cut rates are not measured in any study found, so the social numbers below are convention.

Material Design durations for UI-scale motion: 50-200 ms small utility, 250-400 ms medium, 450-600 ms large expressive, 700-1000 ms ambient. Use these for UI demos inside videos, then scale by the pace preset.
Apple HIG: add motion purposefully, do not add it for its own sake, and respect Reduce Motion. Applies to 'max_simultaneous_moves': fewer is clearer.

presets.name: calm
presets.basis: BPM band = Artlist 'slow/medium-slow'; shot length near classical-era ASL (convention).

presets.name: considered
presets.basis: Explainer VO pace 130-160 wpm (vendor guidance, 150 most cited) implies ~2.5 words/s; on-screen text matches VO.

presets.name: standard
presets.mood: product demo, SaaS launch, LinkedIn, YouTube body
presets.basis: Matches modern feature ASL 3-6 s (Bordwell) at the long end; Material medium/long durations for UI. Convention.

presets.name: energetic
presets.mood: social ads, feature reels, kinetic-swiss, mascot-pop
presets.basis: Artlist 'medium-fast' band. Short-form hook must land in 0-3 s (platform/vendor convention; Facebook counted a view at 3 s per Digiday 2016). Cut cadence is convention.

presets.name: hype
presets.basis: Cut on every beat or half-beat is convention. Keep cards to 1-3 words so the 4 wps reading rate (Brysbaert 238 wpm) still holds at ~0.5-0.9 s per card.

presets.name: trailer
presets.mood: film-style launch film with three acts
presets.camera: act1 slow push-in; act2 parallax trucks; act3 snap zooms and shakes; final hold on title 2-3 s
presets.basis: Three-act cue structure (open, build, big finish) from trailer editors; faster cuts and higher BPM toward the climax (No Film School). Arrays are per act. Insert a 0.5-1.0 s silence before the title hit (convention).

formats.hook: Payoff or claim on screen in 0-1.5 s; motion in frame 1; no logo intro.
formats.safe_zone_1080x1920: Keep text inside ~x 60-960, y 210-1500 (Reels blocks ~210 top / ~310 bottom; TikTok ~108-130 top, 320-480 bottom, 120-150 right). Values are measured by third parties, not published by the platforms.
formats.captions: Burn in; many views start muted (vendor-cited 68% TikTok / 54% Reels, unverified primary).
formats.evidence: Semrush review of 500 trending TikToks: >1/3 show a person speaking within 3 s; >1/2 use music as primary sound in the first 3 s.

formats.hook: State the result in the first 2-3 s; text-first.
formats.captions: Burned-in captions are the most consistent recommendation; design for sound-off. Digiday (2016) reported publishers seeing up to 85% of Facebook video views without sound, the origin of the 'sound-off' norm.

formats.length_s: branded sting 3-5 s max (convention); YouTube measures 'intro' retention at the 30 s mark
formats.hook: Match title/thumbnail promise immediately; logo sting after the hook, not before.
Presenter controls timing; one move per click.
formats.pace: considered; Material medium/long durations; max 1 simultaneous move

formats.hook: Problem or striking product shot in first 5 s; logo/end-card last 3-5 s.
Question or pain point in first 5 s.
Act 1 sets world, act 2 escalates, act 3 montage + title + date.

styles.name: bauhaus-geometric
styles.texture: flat fills, no gradients; optional paper-fibers at 4% alpha
styles.brief: Primary shapes are the actors: circles, squares and triangles assemble into layouts, then dissolve into the next idea. Type is set heavy and geometric on a strict grid. Every move is a straight line or a perfect arc.

styles.name: neo-brutalist
styles.texture: none; hard 4-8 px black offset shadows on every box
styles.brief: Thick black borders, flat loud colors and hard offset shadows. Boxes slam in on snappy springs and stop dead. Copy is short and set big.

styles.name: risograph-print
styles.texture: risograph-misregistration + coarse grain; overlapping inks via multiply
styles.brief: Two or three flat spot inks overprint and shift a few pixels between steps, like a print slightly out of register. Motion steps at 12 fps for shapes while the camera stays smooth. Grain sits on top of everything.

styles.name: blueprint-technical
styles.texture: blueprint grid + faint paper noise
styles.brief: Everything is drawn in thin white lines on deep blue and builds stroke by stroke, with dimension lines and callouts. The camera glides between details like a drafter's eye. Labels type in monospace.

styles.name: terminal-mono
styles.texture: scanlines at 8% optional, slight glow
styles.brief: One monospace font, a blinking cursor and output that streams line by line. Transitions are hard cuts or dithered dissolves. Color is used only for prompts, success and warnings.

styles.name: data-journalism
styles.texture: none; hairline rules and annotations
styles.brief: Serif headlines over white, charts that build axis first, then data, then a single annotated takeaway. One accent color marks the story; everything else is grey. The camera moves only to point at the evidence.

styles.name: paper-cutout-collage
styles.texture: paper-fibers, torn edges (jittered polygon outlines), soft drop shadows offset 3 px
styles.brief: Shapes look cut from colored paper with torn edges and small shadows, layered on a craft-paper ground. Pieces hop in on playful springs and wobble a little at rest, at 12 fps steps. The camera trucks across layers to show depth.

styles.name: claymorphism-soft-3d
styles.texture: inner highlight (top-left white radial) + inner shadow (bottom-right) on rounded shapes
styles.brief: Soft, puffy rounded shapes with inner highlights, as if made of clay. Objects squash and stretch on landing. Pastel ground, chunky rounded type.

styles.name: glass-and-light
styles.texture: frosted panels (blur(24px) of background clipped to roundRect), 1 px white 20% borders, bokeh behind. Opt-in: expensive and overused.
banned: more than 3 glass panels on screen
styles.brief: Frosted translucent panels float over slow colored light, and focus shifts between them. Moves are slow and soft. Opt-in only.

styles.name: y2k-chrome
styles.texture: chrome via multi-stop linearGradient (#fff, #888, #222, #ddd, #fff) with gradient-sweep shine; starbursts
styles.brief: Liquid chrome type with sweeping highlights, star sparkles and electric blue-pink accents. Elements spin and zoom in with punchy springs. Everything shines.

styles.name: retro-vhs
styles.texture: vhs-tracking + crt + chromatic-aberration + timestamp overlay
styles.brief: The whole frame reads as a worn tape: tracking bands roll, colors bleed, a REC timestamp ticks in the corner. Cuts glitch, and titles type on in a blocky display face.

styles.name: pixel-8bit
styles.texture: render at 1/4 or 1/6 res with imageSmoothingEnabled=false, upscale; limited palette
styles.brief: Low-res canvas scaled up with crisp pixels and a tight palette. Motion moves in whole pixels at stepped frame rates. Dialogue boxes type out with blips.

styles.name: split-flap-departures
styles.texture: tile grid with center seam line, subtle vertical gradient per tile

sound.mood: mechanical clatter SFX over minimal electronic

styles.brief: Every word lands on a mechanical departures board, flapping through letters before it settles. Rows update in waves. Amber marks what is new.

styles.name: newsprint
styles.texture: halftone images, paper-fibers, ink spread (blur 0.6px), column rules
styles.brief: Columns, rules and halftone photos on aged paper. Headlines set in a high-contrast serif; the camera reads across the page and zooms into the key line. One red ink for emphasis.

styles.name: isometric-tech
styles.texture: isometric-grid at 6% alpha; flat shaded faces (top light, left mid, right dark)
banned: drop shadows not on the iso axis
styles.brief: Systems drawn as isometric blocks: servers, pipes and data packets moving along iso axes. Blocks rise from the grid on heavy springs. The camera trucks across the diagram.

styles.name: hand-drawn-doodle
styles.texture: jittered strokes (each line drawn 2x with hash offsets ±1 px), boil at 8 fps
styles.brief: Simple black-ink doodles on white, with a yellow marker for emphasis and lines that boil slightly like hand animation. Arrows and circles draw themselves around the key point. Friendly and plain.

styles.name: duotone-photo
styles.texture: duotone mapping + grain 6%
styles.brief: Photos reduced to two strong colors, with tall condensed type cutting across them. Images slowly push in while words slam over the top. Bold and poster-like.

styles.name: swiss-grid-minimal-dark
styles.texture: thin 1 px borders at 8% white; subtle dot-grid; radial glow behind hero at 6%

sound.mood: minimal techno, soft kicks, glassy plucks

styles.brief: Near-black canvas, crisp grey type, hairline borders and one blue accent. UI pieces assemble with quick, damped motion and focus shifts by blur. Precise and quiet.

styles.name: organic-blob-liquid
styles.texture: smooth noise-deformed blobs, soft inner gradients
styles.brief: Shapes are soft blobs that breathe and merge, and scenes change by flowing color. Type is a friendly serif with gentle waves. Warm and calm.

styles.name: monochrome-luxury
styles.texture: fine grain 4%, vignette, occasional light-rays
styles.brief: Black and ivory with one muted gold, wide-tracked serif capitals and long holds. Everything moves slowly and arrives without overshoot. Silence is part of the rhythm.

styles.name: comic-halftone
styles.texture: halftone dots in shading, thick ink outlines, speed lines
styles.brief: Panels with thick ink outlines, halftone shading and starburst sound-effect words. Hits come with snap zooms and shakes. Primary colors only.

styles.name: scandinavian-minimal
styles.texture: subtle paper grain 3%, lots of negative space
banned: more than 2 type sizes per frame
styles.brief: Warm off-white, sage and terracotta, a calm serif headline and generous space. One element moves at a time, eased, with no overshoot. Honest and quiet.

styles.name: corporate-trust
styles.texture: none; soft card shadows (0 8 24 rgba(10,37,64,.08)), light dot-grid

sound.mood: warm corporate pop, piano + soft drums

banned: more than one playful spring per scene
styles.brief: Clean white and navy with one confident blue and a green for positive outcomes. Numbers count up, cards slide into place and people-first copy stays on screen long enough to read. Calm, clear and accountable, suited to insurance and banking.

styles.name: festive-seasonal
styles.texture: snow, bokeh in warm gold, paper-fibers
styles.brief: Deep red, pine green and gold on cream, with slow snow and warm bokeh. Greetings write themselves in script and settle with a soft sparkle. Swap the palette for other seasons.

styles.name: zine-photocopy
styles.texture: high-contrast threshold, toner speckle (seeded dots), tape strips, misaligned crops
styles.brief: Photocopied black and white with toner speckle, taped-on cutouts and one hot accent. Layout is crooked on purpose; elements stutter in at 8-12 fps. Loud and handmade.

styles.name: cyber-hud
styles.texture: line-grid, scanlines 6%, thin corner brackets, glow (shadowBlur 12 cyan)
styles.brief: A heads-up display: corner brackets lock onto targets, readouts decode and rings scan outward. Cyan lines on near-black with a red alert accent. Precise and tense.

styles.name: botanical-engraving
styles.texture: hatching via line patterns, paper-fibers, vignette
styles.brief: Fine-line plant illustrations that draw themselves stroke by stroke on aged paper, with serif captions like a field guide. Slow pans across plates.

logo_reveals.name: stroke-draw-then-fill
logo_reveals.description: Logo outline draws, then fill floods in; wordmark rises.
logo_reveals.implementation: Path2D per logo path; setLineDash([L,L]) dashOffset L*(1-e) over 1.0 s; fill alpha 0->1 over 0.3 s; wordmark rise-from-mask +0.2 s.

logo_reveals.name: mask-slice-reveal
logo_reveals.description: Logo revealed by 3-5 horizontal slices sliding in from alternating sides.
logo_reveals.implementation: for slice k: clip rect band k; translate x = (k%2?1:-1)*W*(1-spring(t-t0-k*0.05,320,30)); drawImage(logo).

logo_reveals.name: shape-assemble
logo_reveals.description: Logo built from primitive parts that fly in and lock together.
logo_reveals.implementation: Decompose into parts with final transforms; start transforms seeded off-screen/rotated; per part lerp transform with spring heavy, stagger 0.06; 2-frame flash at lock.

logo_reveals.name: dot-morph-to-logo
logo_reveals.description: A dot (cursor or click ripple) grows and morphs into the logo mark (container morph).
logo_reveals.implementation: circle -> logo path via morph-shape-to-shape (N=128 resampled points), spring ui; color lerp.

logo_reveals.name: ink-bleed-reveal
logo_reveals.description: Logo emerges through a spreading ink blob.
logo_reveals.implementation: ink-liquid-bleed clip centered on logo; logo drawn inside; blob edge noise freezes as it settles.

logo_reveals.name: letter-stagger-lockup
logo_reveals.description: Wordmark letters rise with stagger, then mark scales in beside it and pushes letters into final spacing.
logo_reveals.implementation: rise-from-mask chars stagger 0.03; mark scale 0->1 spring playful; letter x offsets spring ui from centered to lockup layout.

logo_reveals.name: light-sweep-glint
logo_reveals.description: Logo static, a specular highlight sweeps across once; optional lens glint.
logo_reveals.implementation: draw logo; ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-atop'; linearGradient band (transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.8), transparent) at x = lerp(-w, w, easeInOutSine(p)), skewed 20 deg.

logo_reveals.name: macro-pull-out
logo_reveals.description: Starts extreme close on a logo detail, pulls out to reveal the whole mark and tagline.
logo_reveals.implementation: camera pull-out from s=8 to 1 about detail point with spring camera; tagline fade-up after s<1.2.

logo_reveals.name: glitch-resolve
logo_reveals.description: Logo appears corrupted (RGB split, slices) and snaps to clean.
logo_reveals.implementation: glitch-rgb-split for 0.4 s with amplitude decaying to 0; final frame clean + subtle scanline fade.

logo_reveals.name: split-flap-resolve
logo_reveals.description: Brand name lands on split-flap tiles, mark fades in beside it.
logo_reveals.implementation: split-flap-board on wordmark chars; mark fade-in after last char settles.

logo_reveals.name: stamp-slam
logo_reveals.description: Logo slams down from scale 3 with shake, ink spread and a thud.
logo_reveals.implementation: big-number-slam math on logo; seeded-shake A=14; ink splatter ring (seeded short strokes) at impact.

logo_reveals.name: orbit-converge
logo_reveals.description: Small dots orbit and spiral into the center, forming the mark (opt-in particles; keep count low).
logo_reveals.implementation: N=24 dots: radius r = R*(1-e), angle = a0 + 4*TAU*e; at e>0.85 crossfade to logo with scale pop.

logo_reveals.name: end-card-three-beat
logo_reveals.description: End card: logo, then one-line CTA, then URL/handle; each a beat apart; hold 2-3 s.
logo_reveals.implementation: beat 1 logo reveal (any above); beat 2 CTA fade-up; beat 3 URL in mono with underline-draw; hold; optional subtle push-in 1.0->1.03 so the hold isn't frozen.

logo_reveals.name: end-card-loop-back
logo_reveals.description: Final frame matches first frame for seamless social loops.
logo_reveals.implementation: Last 1 s transitions (push or match-cut) into a frame rendered identical to t=0; verify by diffing frame 0 vs last frame.

logo_reveals.name: end-card-qr-cta
logo_reveals.description: Logo + QR code + CTA for events/screens; QR draws in by modules.
logo_reveals.implementation: QR modules from a precomputed matrix; module (i,j) appears when hash(i,j) < e (or diagonal wave); finder patterns first; hold >= 4 s for scanning.

logo_reveals.name: underline-sign-off
logo_reveals.description: Logo with a hand-drawn underline or signature swoosh that draws under it.
logo_reveals.implementation: logo fade-up; underline-draw swoosh Path2D with lineDash 0.5 s; final hold.
